transport.title: Airport metro
transport.text: Xinzheng Airport station is served by the Chengjiao and Zhengxu lines; exit G is signposted for T2 and exit E for T1. On the Chengjiao line towards Jiahe/Liuzhuang, the first train departs at 06:00 and the last at 22:15, with the same times on working days and holidays. On the Zhengxu line towards Xuchang East, the first train is at 06:14 and the last at 21:14. Metro information: +86 371 55166166.
